info.name: HRMS API
info.description:
HRMS API — folders match the two dashboards.

**0. Setup** — Health + login (all roles). Password: {{password}}
**1. Admin Dashboard** — Roles, Users, Employee Management, Masters write, Mail, Manual attendance
**2. Employee Dashboard (ESS)** — My permissions, My profile, Punch in/out, Master dropdowns

baseUrl = {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:9001)

Seeded emails: {{globalAdminEmail}} | {{adminEmail}} | {{hrEmail}} | {{managerEmail}} | {{employeeEmail}}

Auth: Bearer {{token}} after login. Custom roles: catalog admin|employee + permissions matrix gates each module.

item.name: 0. Setup — Health & Login
item.description: Start here. Login as the role you want to test (token → {{token}}).

request.description:
Simple root check (no token).

Response:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": "ok",
  "message": "HRMS API is working",
  "name": "HRMS API",
  "version": "1.0.0"
}
```

Public health check — no token.
Checks API + MongoDB.

Healthy (200):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": "ok",
  "message": "HRMS API is healthy",
  "mongodb": "connected"
}
```

Down (503):
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": "down",
  "message": "MongoDB is not connected",
  "mongodb": "disconnected"
}
```

Global Admin — all companies (lean login account, no employee profile).
Sets {{token}} + {{userId}}.
Email: globaladmin@techculture.ai

Super Admin — own company (lean account: login + company only).
Sets {{token}} + {{userId}}.
Email: shivangi@techculture.ai

HR Manager — own company + employee profile.
Email: hr@techculture.ai

Manager — own company + employee profile.
Email: manager@techculture.ai

Sets {{token}} + {{userId}}.
Then use **Update Profile (Employee)** — personal only (phones etc). No official{}.
Clears httpOnly cookie `token`. Browser clients should call this on sign-out.

request.description:
Update permissions for custom / HR / Manager / Employee roles.
Body: catalog (admin|employee) + permissions array — keep/remove modules.
Super Admin / Global Admin locked (full access).
Var {{roleCatalog}} default = admin.

Super Admin / Global Admin cannot be deleted.
Other roles deletable when no user has that role.
Login as Super Admin. Set {{roleId}}.
POST /api/users — create lean user (any role). Sets {{userId}}.
Create Super Admin. Global Admin → any company; Super Admin → own company only.
Create HR Manager from Access & Control drawer.

Only Global Admin can create another Global Admin (lean, empty company).
Soft cap MAX_GLOBAL_ADMINS (default 5). Super Admin cannot create Global Admin.
Role appears in GET /api/roles only for Global Admin login.
GET /api/users — filters + pagination. Hierarchy by actor role.
GET /api/users/export — .xlsx (Access & Control → export). Same filters as list.
GET /api/users/:id
PUT /api/users/:id — Edit drawer. Email + company locked. Blank password = keep.
POST /api/users/:id/mail — row mail icon. Uses user officialEmail.
DELETE /api/users/:id — separate delete API. Cannot delete self.

request.description:
Full nested profile for Employee / HR / Manager.
Login as Global Admin / Super Admin / HR Manager.

officialEmail + department required; company defaults to {{company}}.
Change {{newUserEmail}} and {{employeeCode}} before each create.

Employee Management — **only role = Employee**.

For Access & Control (all roles) use **List Users** → GET /api/users.

Columns: _id, name, email, role, department, lastLogin, status, employeeCode, gender, designation, branch.
Global Admin → all companies. Super Admin / HR / Manager → own company.
GET /api/employees/export — admin only (not Employee role).

PUT /api/employees/{{userId}} — ALL objects (admin).

personal | official | other | education | accounts | family | nominees | experience | visas | payroll

Edit values in Collection → Variables. Login Super Admin first.
Same PUT API — Super Admin / HR Manager only

formdata.description: PDF, JPG, PNG or DOC. File must be a real file, not a folder.

request.description:
No user id. Login token is enough.

Form-data:
- type = education | account
- document = file

Same type always saves in the same Cloudinary folder:
hrms/education or hrms/account.
Response url use on Submit (PUT /api/employees/:id):
- education → education[].document (url only)
- account → accounts[].attachment

Section PUT removed. Use PUT /api/employees/:id with one nested key.
One object with _id updates that row; without _id appends. Array replaces the list.
Same for education, family, nominees, experience, visas.
Admin only. PUT /api/employees/:id with official{}. Employee gets 403.
Admin only. PUT /api/employees/:id with payroll{}.
Super Admin / HR Manager / Manager only. Clears payroll. Official cannot be deleted.

Delete rows. One object { _id }, or an array of ids.
Section: education, accounts, family, nominees, experience, or visas.
Super Admin / HR Manager / Manager. Cannot delete self.

Employee tracking by id.
GET /api/employees/{{userId}}/activity
Employee → own id. Admin → that employee.
Each log: employee{}, actor{}, action, section, summary, changes, createdAt.

Admin company-wide tracking.
GET /api/employees/activity
Optional: company, employeeId, actorId, action, page, limit.
Company master: `name` is the company name (no parent company field).
Use `data[].name` in employee create/update official.department.
Global Admin only. Body has no parent `company` — `name` is the company.
Writes to `departments` collection. Fields: type, name, status, company (no code).
Writes to `designations` collection. Fields: type, name, status, company (no code).
Set {{masterId}} from create/list response `_id`.

Organization → Mail.
Needs Mail → email permission (Global/Super Admin always allowed).
Optional: cc, bcc (string or array), isHtml: true for HTML body.
Admin only. Vars: userId, punchType, punchTime, punchReason, punchRemarks
Query vars: attendanceDate, punchSource. Remove query if not needed.
